# MM-P2-L2-RR03-S2 - Fastener inspection and torque - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

## Scope
This document describes the required fastener inspection and torque verification process for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03). It covers inspection of accessible structural, bearing cover, and guarding fasteners and lubrication point verification for operation on rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm. Refer to SB-1049 for safety barriers and lockout guidance.

## Tools
- Hand wrench set and calibrated torque device (use device calibrated per site procedure).  
- Inspection mirror and flashlight.  
- Clean lint-free cloth and approved lubricant CFW-LUB-101.  
- Equipment documentation: SOP-P2-L2-01, SOP-P2-L2-05.

## Procedure
- Perform lockout/tagout in accordance with SB-1049 before any inspection.  
- Visually inspect all accessible fasteners on EQ-P2-L2-RR03 for missing, loose, or damaged hardware. Use inspection mirror to view concealed locations.  
- Clean fastener heads and surrounding surfaces with lint-free cloth. Confirm lubricant availability and apply CFW-LUB-101 to designated lubrication points as documented in SOP-P2-L2-05.  
- Verify and set fastener torque values using the calibrated torque device. Apply torque values and methods as specified in SOP-P2-L2-01; do not apply ad hoc torque values.  
- Record each fastener inspected, action taken, lubricant replenished, and reference to SOPs in the maintenance log.

## Acceptance criteria
- All inspected fasteners are present and show no visual damage or movement after torque verification.  
- Torque has been applied per SOP-P2-L2-01 and documented for each fastener.  
- Lubricant CFW-LUB-101 applied where required and recorded per SOP-P2-L2-05.  
- Maintenance actions and LOTO reference to SB-1049 are completed and filed with the equipment record.
